title: Build an MCP Server
blurb: Implement the core of a Model Context Protocol server: JSON-RPC parsing, tool descriptors, argument validation, tool calls and resources.
intro: The Model Context Protocol lets any AI application talk to any tool or data server over JSON-RPC 2.0. The steps build a minimal server from the message layer up: classify incoming messages and pick the right error codes, describe tools with a JSON Schema, validate the model's arguments against it, answer `tools/call` while keeping protocol errors separate from tool errors, and serve static and templated resources. The capstone runs a whole session (initialisation, version negotiation, listing, calls and reads) over a stream of raw messages. Transports, concurrency and authentication are left out to keep the core visible.
